name: Warden Aldous

intro.text: Welcome to the Sheffield Heritage Experience! The steel has been curated, the hills have been curated, and the pigeons are, regrettably, still wild.

win: A very decent win. I'll say it was a tie in my report.
after: The Enclosure has plans for a tasteful Kelham Island Experience. Possibly with a theme park. I'm told the mill said no.
